newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trichet - BoF branch restructuring not on agenda.
newsitem.headline: Trichet - BoF branch restructuring not on agenda.

text.p: Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet told the central bank's employees on Friday that a restructuring of the bank's branch network was not on the agenda.
"The project for the restructuring of the branch network has not been started," Trichet said in a statement distributed to employees.

However Trichet said the central bank expected to reduce the level of operations at a certain number of its units, due to a decline in use by institutional clients, although there were no definite plans as yet.
